capabilities: Catalog anime, manga, and novels in Markdown notes
Fetch metadata and covers from Bangumi, AniList, and Open Library
Track episode, chapter, and volume progress with ratings
Sync watch status and progress two-way with Bangumi
Visualize scores in a dashboard and completion timeline
extras: Fork of cwh555/AnimeList that auto-migrates the original plugin's data.json settings and stays 100% compatible with its animelist code-block syntax; all data stays local except on-demand metadata searches, update checks, and Bangumi sync.
intentEvidence: 本项目基于 cwh555/AnimeList 进行深度二次开发与增强
motivation: The author deep-redeveloped the original AnimeList plugin to add Bangumi two-way sync, full Simplified Chinese localization, and corrected airing-season logic that the original lacked.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track anime, manga, or novel collections with watch/read progress, ratings, covers, and airing-season metadata inside Markdown notes.
